field_menu.doc: The field menu (M2-UI-04; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Field menu). Rects are top-left x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3 so every edge lands on a whole pixel at 1280 x 720. 'root' and 'detail' are MenuPage metrics blocks (the same keys as battle_hud.json commands); a page is as tall as its rows need (MenuPage.height_for), 'detail' up to max_rows. 'desc' holds the line about the highlighted row: at the top of the right column on the root, else 'gap' under the right page, which is as tall as its rows. canvas_layer sits under the bestiary's (64), which opens over it. M2-MNU-01..04 grew the root to nine rows (Items, Equip, Lattice, Status, Swell, Bestiary, Settings, Quit, Close) and the panel with it, and widened the root (no right column there: cost_width 0) so 'Return to the path' fits at 130% text. M2-UI-18 added Map after Swell (ten rows; the panel grew to 687 and moved up so it stays centred). M2-MNU-07 added Formation after Status and M3-UI-03 Codex after Bestiary (twelve rows; each row grew the panel and root by one pitch, 48, moved them up by half of it and the objective block down by half, so it stays at the foot of the right column). 'objective' (M2-UI-17): the current objective at the foot of the right column on the root, a dim 'Objective' head of label_height over the line; hidden where the zone has no map. 'last_save' (M2-MNU-300, the Lead's call: no save row; saving stays at shrines): the root's Last saved block above the objective, three lines of line_height (a dim head, the newest save's place and time or 'Not saved yet', and the shrine reminder); hidden when the menu has no save system (tests). 'party' (M2-MNU-304): the active line as cards (PartyCard: portrait, name, HP and MP) between the line about the highlighted row and Last saved, card_w x card_h each, spacing apart; root only; a fallen hero's card at fallen_alpha.

extra_rows.doc: M3-UI-205: while the root has more rows than its usual twelve (the Kite's, once the Kite flies), FieldMenu.grown_for grows each 'grow' block by one root row_pitch per extra row and moves it up by half of that, and moves each 'follow' block down by half, the same steps every earlier row took.
